1	# Launch, Return, And Settlement Contract
2	
3	Read this reference completely before invoking an Agent or settling a returned
4	lane. `runtime_receipts.py`, `workers.py`, `loop_journal.py`, and the frozen run
5	records are authoritative over prose.
6	
7	## Binary Launch Contract
8	
9	`workers.py delegate` returns an exact `subagent_type` plus exact `launch_prompt`.
10	Use those two returned values unchanged in one Agent tool input. `delegate` never
11	spawns the Agent.
12	
13	Canonical execution roles map only to `xunji-hunter`; role `review` maps only to
14	`xunji-reviewer`. Missing, null, blank, `general-purpose`, aliased,
15	case-shifted, role-swapped, or whitespace-padded types fail closed. The requested
16	type and actual same-session Start/Stop type must agree.
17	
18	The complete Hunter prompt has this formatter-owned shape:
19	
20	```text
21	XUNJI_ASSIGNMENT=A-... XUNJI_FRONT=F-... XUNJI_ASSETS=h1,h2 XUNJI_LANE=L-... XUNJI_PLAN=<64hex> XUNJI_INSTRUCTION_BUNDLE=<64hex>
22	```
23	
24	The dependent Reviewer also binds `XUNJI_RESULT_DIGEST=<64hex>` and its required
25	completion marker. Complete-string equality is the boundary: do not prepend,
26	append, normalize, trim, reorder, or rebuild it in `description`.
27	
28	The instruction digest binds the manifest-selected common/role/live Agent
29	sources and the generated context/scaffold bytes. Root launch, `SubagentStart`,
30	and every child PreToolUse revalidate it; a source drift or artifact mismatch is
31	a blocker requiring material replan/delegate, never in-place repair.
32	
33	## Launch And Return
34	
35	- An async Agent Post with `status=async_launched` proves launch only.
36	- Only one uniquely matching `SubagentStop` from the same Claude session proves
37	  return and freezes the final assistant response.
38	- Parent Post without Stop, heartbeat, Agent prose, Task state, copied output,
39	  completion notification, or an internal max-turn notification is not return.
40	- Do not configure `maxTurns`. Each Agent must end with a final assistant response;
41	  near its lane budget it returns a bounded candidate, refutation, or blocker.
42	- Root alone spawns Agents. Child fan-out is rejected.
